text:
Maya (Growth): Quick sync — finalizing webinar format for May 14. Working title: 'Inference in the Wild: live cost lab + micro-benchmarks'. Need decisions on breakout topics, speaker slots, rehearsal windows, and how we route leads. TL;DR: 40m main + 20m breakouts + 20m live Q&A.

Cheng (Eng): love the lab idea. can we make each breakout a single hands-on notebook with 3 steps: 1) pick model variant, 2) run budget calc, 3) inspect latency tradeoffs. keep infra light (no GPU requirement).

Samir (Product): agree. also suggest a live poll during the intro to pick which prompt we demo in the main demo — increases engagement. recommend /poll or Slido embed.

Liz (Speaker Ops): who are firm speakers? need availability and 2 rehearsal slots (dry run + tech check). can everyone do T-2 days (rehearsal) and T-0.5 hours (greenroom)? :calendar:

Alex (Benchmarks): I can build a 3-step cost calculator (embed or google sheet) that takes token counts + batch size + quantization and outputs $/1k tokens and latency estimate. will prep 3 saved configs: "fast-cheap", "balanced", "high-quality".

Priya (Panelist): happy to take the panel/QA. prefer afternoon slot. can demo a quick real-world prompt (customer onboarding flow).

Maya (Growth): perfect — action items: Alex to produce cost calc + 3 configs; Cheng to make notebooks for 3 breakouts; Samir to set up poll; Liz to book rehearsals. also need lead routing plan: where do signups go? SFDC campaign, Marketo list, and a webhook to /events/webinar-inference.

Cheng (Eng): for notebooks I'll keep them runnable in Colab, ~6 cells max. breakouts: A) cost pruning & batching, B) quantization tradeoffs, C) routing & fallbacks. each has a 7min guided run + 3min debrief.

Alex (Benchmarks): sample output i'll use in slides:

```
Config: balanced
Model: open-7b-q4
Prompt tokens: 150
Completion tokens: 120
Batch: 4
Estimated $/1k tokens: $0.18
p50 latency (seq=512): 220ms
```

Samir (Product): Poll text suggestion: "Which breakout would you join?" options: "A Cost & Batching", "B Quantization", "C Routing & Fallbacks". let's run the poll at T+2 minutes and pin results for breakout assignment.

Liz (Speaker Ops): Rehearsal windows proposed: May 12 10:00-11:00 PT (dry run) and May 14 09:30-10:00 PT (greenroom). can speakers confirm? @Priya @Alex @Cheng

Priya (Panelist): confirm May 12 dry run works. May 14 greenroom also OK.

Alex (Benchmarks): confirm both. will upload cost calc and a short README to the drive by EOD Friday.

Cheng (Eng): confirm both. will push notebooks to the repo and add a one-click Colab link in the session doc.

Maya (Growth): Lead routing details: we tag with campaign code "webinar_inference_may_14"; Marketo list "Webinar_Inference_May14"; SFDC → Campaign "Webinar: Inference 2024-05-14"; webhook for instant opt-ins to /events/webinar-inference (Dev to confirm payload). also capture demo interest checkbox to route to AE queue.

Samir (Product): Dev note for webhook: payload should include email, company, interest_flag, utm_source. will ask eng to send sample schema.

GreenroomBot: rehearsal created: May 12 10:00 PT (dry run) — meeting link sent to participants. May 14 09:30 PT greenroom — reminder at T-30m.

Liz (Speaker Ops): run-of-show draft (keep crisp):

```
00:00 - 00:05 Intro + poll
00:05 - 00:20 Live cost lab demo (Alex)
00:20 - 00:40 Breakouts (3 rooms, 7m hands-on + 3m debrief)
00:40 - 00:55 Panel + live Q&A
00:55 - 01:00 Wrap / CTA / post-event survey
```

Liz (Speaker Ops): one more ask — can we get 2 short promo clips (30s) from speakers: 1) technical callout, 1) customer benefit. we'll use for final email and socials.

Maya (Growth): will draft copy for email and social, push by Mon. also planning a follow-up nurture flow for 'download cost workbook' and 'request dedicated demo'.

Cheng (Eng): small prod concern — breakout C will reference routing fallback policies. will add a tiny emulator so folks can try switching models locally (no infra required).

Alex (Benchmarks): timeline check: deliverables by EOD Fri: cost calc + slide snapshot. notebooks pushed by EOD Mon. poll created by Samir by Tue.

Samir (Product): will create poll and Slido event by Tue noon. will share embed snippet for the slide deck.

Liz (Speaker Ops): noted. I'll also create a speaker cheat sheet (3 bullets each) and share in the rehearsal.

Maya (Growth): excellent. if no objections, I'll lock the format and start invite flow tonight. final ask: any must-not-do's for the demo? keep it reproducible (no private keys, no long-running GPU jobs).

Cheng (Eng): agree — no GPU dependencies and include seed scripts.

Priya (Panelist): thumbs up. excited! :rocket:

Maya (Growth): thanks everyone — locking format unless someone objects by EOD tomorrow.

Liz (Speaker Ops): copy that. I'll ping when rehearsal calendar invites are sent. :white_check_mark:
